keyEvents.text: Luke Garbutt (Salford City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Stephen Wearne (Carlisle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Taylor Allen (Salford City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Penalty saved. Ryan Graydon (Salford City) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Archie Mair (Carlisle United).
Archie Mair (Carlisle United) Penalty - Saved at 36'
Goal! Carlisle United 1, Salford City 0. David Ajiboye (Carlisle United) with an attempt from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Stephen Wearne.
Bradley Nicholson (Carlisle United) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
